organisers: ICOM Germany · Austria · Switzerland · Guests: ICOM France and ICOM Italy
aboutLead: Every three years, the ICOM national committees of Germany, Austria and Switzerland meet for the International Bodensee Symposium. In 2027, ICOM Switzerland hosts the 19th edition at the Bern Museum Quarter.
aboutText:
The symposium takes its name from Lake Constance (Bodensee), where the three countries meet, and moves between the three committees in turn. It is a place for museum professionals to compare practice across borders and to discuss what museum work needs next. Reflecting Switzerland's languages and neighbours, ICOM France and ICOM Italy join this edition as guests.

The symposium is part of a week that belongs to Europe's museums. From 26 to 30 May 2027, Bern hosts EMYA2027, the 50th-anniversary edition of the European Museum of the Year Award. Registration for both events runs through the EMYA2027 website.

week.text: The Learning Museum, at the Bern Museum Quarter. Organised by ICOM Germany, ICOM Austria and ICOM Switzerland, with ICOM France and ICOM Italy as guests.
